name: Review
what: A review: a card rises, the stars pop in one after another and fill (a half star fills half), the quote appears word by word, the reviewer's picture and name slide in, a score line comes in under the card.
origin: testimonials and ratings - the template kinds marketplaces list (Mixkit, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Videohive), researched 2026-10-16
motion: card 16 f (slow end); stars back.out 10 f, 4 f apart, filling 8 f; words 2 f apart (6 f each); picture back.out 12 f, name 10 f
